traces.name: p1-02-good
traces.why: The history of P1-02 the specification describes.

traces.name: p1-02-good-other-interleaving
traces.why: The same history with independent records interleaved differently: also accepted.

traces.name: p1-02b-good
traces.why: P1-02b: an old unknown answer arrives after the commit is known, and nothing follows it.

traces.name: trace-cut-before-footer
traces.why: The trace was cut: no footer. Nothing is concluded from it.

traces.name: trace-cut-inside-a-record
traces.why: The last line was cut in the middle of a record.

traces.name: trace-record-missing
traces.why: A record is missing: the collector sequence and one origin sequence have a gap.

traces.name: trace-missing-the-commit-of-the-admission
traces.why: The missing record is the commit: an acknowledgement without admission is not concluded.

traces.name: trace-missing-the-publish-of-the-client
traces.why: The missing record is the PUBLISH: an admission outside any exchange is not concluded.

traces.name: trace-origin-gap
traces.why: The collector sequence is gapless and the footer agrees, yet one origin skips a number.

traces.name: trace-collector-gap
traces.why: The collector sequence skips a number: a record did not reach the file.

traces.name: trace-record-not-valid
traces.why: One line is not a valid record: its sequences are in order, its payload is not of its kind.

traces.name: trace-cause-missing
traces.why: A record names a cause that is not in the trace.

traces.name: trace-footer-count-wrong
traces.why: The footer counts more records than the trace holds.

traces.name: trace-footer-not-complete
traces.why: The collector itself says the trace is not complete.

traces.name: trace-consequence-before-cause
traces.why: In a simulated run the core consumes a packet before the transport received its bytes.

traces.name: trace-record-claims-another-origin
traces.why: A recovery page is stated by the bench: the record breaks the origin rule and the trace is unreadable.

traces.name: trace-of-another-scenario
traces.why: A complete trace of P1-02b is offered for P1-02: a run is judged only against its own scenario.

traces.name: admission-hidden-behind-a-fresh-exchange
traces.why: DEM-MU-04: the replay is admitted again under a new ExchangeId; one client exchange has two admissions.

traces.name: admission-twice-on-a-cut-trace
traces.why: The trace is cut, and what it holds already shows two admissions: no missing record undoes that.

traces.name: admission-outside-any-exchange
traces.why: The store commits an admission of Packet Identifier 7 before the client sent any PUBLISH.

traces.name: acknowledged-without-admission
traces.why: The client observes a positive PUBREC for an exchange the store never admitted.

traces.name: obligation-destination-changed
traces.why: DEM-MU-06: two obligations at both checkpoints, but one now targets another session.

traces.name: obligation-gone
traces.why: An obligation held at the first checkpoint is absent at the second.

traces.name: obligation-not-the-required-one
traces.why: The same two obligations at both checkpoints, and one is not towards a target of the route.

traces.name: obligation-payload-changed
traces.why: The obligations keep their identities and destinations; the payload they refer to changed.

traces.name: obligation-none-held
traces.why: Both checkpoints agree, on nothing: the store holds no publication and no obligation.

traces.name: obligation-appeared
traces.why: The second checkpoint holds one obligation more for the same publication: not the same obligations.

traces.name: obligation-towards-a-session-the-store-lost
traces.why: The store holds no session for a target of the route: a finding, not a crash of the judge.

traces.name: recipe-changed-under-its-identity
traces.why: The recipe stored for op_A has other targets at the second checkpoint.

traces.name: recipe-lost
traces.why: op_A was committed before the second inspection, which holds no recipe for it.

traces.name: pubrec-eligible-on-a-hidden-commit
traces.why: The store had committed and the core had not been told: the PUBREC is premature.

traces.name: pubcomp-eligible-before-its-result
traces.why: PUBCOMP is made eligible before the core received the result of the release.

traces.name: pubrec-observed-before-the-crash
traces.why: The result was not lost: the client observed PUBREC before the crash.

traces.name: fault-hit-twice
traces.why: The injection was reached twice; once was announced.

traces.name: provenance-result-answers-no-effect
traces.why: DEM-MU-03: after the restart the core receives a result for op_A that answers no effect of this incarnation.

traces.name: provenance-page-holds-a-fact-nobody-read
traces.why: DEM-MU-03: the page the core consumed holds a fact the store adapter did not read.

traces.name: recovery-inventory-over-three-pages
traces.why: The inventory of a recovery is cut inside its routes and inside its sessions: still one ordered inventory.

traces.name: recovery-routes-unsorted-across-pages
traces.why: Each page is in order, and the first route of the second page sorts before the last of the first.

traces.name: recovery-limits-after-the-routes-of-an-earlier-page
traces.why: Each page is in order, and the limits come in a page after the routes they bound.

traces.name: recovery-route-table-again-in-a-later-page
traces.why: Each page is in order, and the second page states the route table a second time.

traces.name: recovery-route-without-its-table
traces.why: Routes belong to the table that precedes them: an inventory with routes and no table is not one.

traces.name: provenance-input-refused
traces.why: The dispatcher refused a result that answered no effect in flight.

traces.name: provenance-deadline-never-armed
traces.why: The core consumes a deadline whose token no timer armed.

traces.name: provenance-deadline-delivered-twice
traces.why: The first deadline of P1-02b is delivered a second time.

traces.name: provenance-packet-without-bytes
traces.why: The core consumes a PUBLISH that follows no bytes of the transport.

traces.name: provenance-result-delivered-twice
traces.why: One effect is answered twice.

traces.name: p1-02-good-duplicate-refused
traces.why: A declared injection duplicates a result; the dispatcher refuses the copy, and that is the expected outcome.

traces.name: provenance-duplicate-reaches-the-core
traces.why: The duplicated result is not refused: the core consumes a second answer to one effect.

traces.name: snapshot-not-the-cited-file
traces.why: The final snapshot is not the file the trace cites: what depends on it is not concluded.

traces.name: p1-02-good-identities-in-another-member-order
traces.why: An identity is its named components, in whatever order a writer puts the members.

traces.name: snapshot-of-another-run
traces.why: The final snapshot is a valid snapshot of another run: it is not evidence for this one.

traces.name: snapshot-of-another-store
traces.why: The final snapshot was read from another backend than the run declares.

traces.name: provenance-packets-nobody-sent
traces.why: The transport records bytes no peer sent, and they are not the packets the core consumed.

traces.name: provenance-bytes-are-not-what-the-peer-sent
traces.why: The transport records other bytes than the peer sent for the packet the core consumed.

traces.name: provenance-bytes-caused-by-no-peer
traces.why: The bytes the transport received name as their cause a record that is not a packet a peer sent.

traces.name: provenance-packet-of-another-kind-than-the-bytes
traces.why: The peer sent a PUBLISH, the transport received it, and the core consumed a PUBREL.

traces.name: provenance-packet-of-another-identifier-than-the-bytes
traces.why: The bytes received carry another Packet Identifier than the packet the core consumed.

traces.name: provenance-bytes-are-more-than-the-packet
traces.why: The bytes received are more than the one packet the core consumed.

traces.name: snapshot-of-another-checkpoint
traces.why: The file cited for the final checkpoint is the snapshot of another checkpoint.

traces.name: snapshot-checkpoint-inspected-twice
traces.why: The first checkpoint is inspected twice: neither inspection is the one the scenario asks for.

traces.name: provenance-refusal-not-caused-by-a-duplication
traces.why: An input is refused after an injection that duplicates nothing: the refusal is not excused.

traces.name: core-without-bytes-good
traces.why: A run without bytes, judged against the scenario of that perimeter.

traces.name: core-without-bytes-against-the-full-scenario
traces.why: A run without bytes is offered for the full scenario: it never passes it.

traces.name: full-run-against-a-scenario-without-bytes
traces.why: A full run is offered for the scenario of another perimeter.

traces.name: core-without-bytes-lists-a-peer-assertion
traces.why: A scenario without bytes lists an assertion only peers can decide: it stays out of scope.

traces.name: core-without-bytes-result-answers-no-effect
traces.why: Without bytes the provenance of results is still checked.

traces.name: qabs-a-good
traces.why: QABS-A: the command commits before the fence; one effect.

traces.name: qabs-b-good
traces.why: QABS-B: the fence commits first; the old command is refused.

traces.name: qabs-c-good
traces.why: QABS-C: no fence can be written; the outcome stays unknown.

traces.name: fenced-command-executed
traces.why: A command is committed after the fence that made it definitively not executable.

traces.name: snapshot-holds-a-fenced-commit
traces.why: No commit is in the trace, yet the store holds the operation both fenced and committed.

traces.name: certain-rejection-without-a-fence
traces.why: DEM-MU-01: the store answers a certain refusal though its fence was refused.

traces.name: refusal-with-a-quota-for-a-fence
traces.why: The admission is refused because it was fenced, and the PUBREC says a quota is the cause.

traces.name: refusal-for-lack-of-capacity
traces.why: The admission is refused for lack of capacity: the PUBREC says a quota is the cause.

traces.name: refusal-for-lack-of-capacity-without-the-quota
traces.why: The admission is refused for lack of capacity, and the PUBREC hides that a quota is the cause.

traces.name: refusal-answering-no-rejection
traces.why: The PUBREC refuses, and no certain rejection is among its causes.

traces.name: refusal-answering-an-unknown-outcome
traces.why: The PUBREC refuses, and the result among its causes is an unknown outcome, not a rejection.

traces.name: certain-rejection-without-a-fence-on-a-cut-trace
traces.why: The trace is cut: the fence that closes the refusal may be the record that is missing.

traces.name: fenced-command-executed-on-a-cut-trace
traces.why: The trace is cut, and it already holds a commit after its fence: no missing record undoes that.
